cases.refreshed: Come celebrate Diwali, the festival of light over darkness, and create henna designs on a LED candle to take home. For children 3rd grade to 8th grade. No registration required. While supplies last. Space is limited.

events.title: Handcrafted Yarn & Fabric Winter Birds Craft

cases.refreshed: Join community educator and sustainable artist Leila Ghasempor to bring the charm of winter wildlife into your home! Participants will learn how to create adorable, tactile winter songbirds using yarn and fabric. These sweet handmade creations can be displayed as seasonal decorations, ornaments, or tabletop accents. A fun and accessible workshop for all skill levels. Programs is designed for adults and teens. All supplies will be provided. No registration necessary. Seating will be offered on a first-come, first-served basis.

events.title: Book Bugs Club for 2nd and 3rd Graders

cases.refreshed: Are you a second or third grader? Do you like to read books and talk about them with other kids? Then The Book Bugs Club is for you! Our November book selection is The Mystery of the Gold Coin by Harper Paris. At our book club meeting we will discuss the book and enjoy a fun craft or activity. Please pick up a copy of the book at the Children's Desk at Los Altos Library or at Woodland Library for check out. Please read the book at home before our meeting. Space is limited. This event will take place in the Los Altos Library Orchard Room.
